tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Searches the Verateca register of dietary supplements by product name, brand, ingredient or barcode. Returns up to 10 published products with id, brand, form, page address, lowest price per day where prices are published, number of offers and the date the record was checked. Results are ordered by m

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Returns one published product record: composition as the label states it, daily amounts, the applicable upper limit of the country for each ingredient with its share, limits of other countries, the status in the country, prices per day where published, and the dates of each part.

tools.name: get_ingredient
tools.description: Returns one substance of the register: its forms with the share of the element where known, the upper limit of the country first, then the limits of other countries with type, source and the date checked, reference sources, and the number of published products that contain it.

tools.name: check_stack
tools.description: Adds up each ingredient across several products taken together (up to 12) and compares each daily total with the adult upper limit of the country, with the same rules engine as the Verateca site. tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Puts 2 to 6 published products side by side: daily dose, price per day where published, and for each ingredient the daily amount and its share of the applicable upper limit of the country.

tools.name: get_selection_link
tools.description: Returns the address of the Verateca order page for one of its three paid services (quick, full, review), with the price and currency the site shows for the country and a one-line description. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_selection_link · Private data: search_products, get_product · Public sink: get_product, get_ingredient, check_stack, compare_products.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_selection_link · Private data: search_products, get_product · Public sink: get_product, get_ingredient, check_stack, compare_products

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
